title: Dinghy Driver
description: The wee ferryman at Starport Borgo, a diminutive Teek, carried crews from their ships in the docking area to the port itself for a fee. When the Onyx Cinder arrived, he ferried Wim, Fern, KB, and Neel to the chaotic port. When he demanded payment, he got much more than he bargained for when Wim gave him a genuine datary.
